name: CanonicalWireframe NodeTypes
purpose: Define CanonicalWireframe NodeTypes, Entity-local Property expectations, required Link minima, and abstraction boundary node roles using Canonical Contract Format 2.0.

model.ccf: Defines canonical Entity and Property structure.
model.nodetypes: Define what Property types and Link minima an Entity of a given NodeType owns or is expected to satisfy.
model.rulesets: Interpret canonical structure, Property semantics, Link roles, required-Link matching, causality, flow and abstraction boundary behavior.

rules: Entity.entity_type_ref resolves a NodeType by id inside the active NodeTypes registry.
NodeTypes describe Entity-local Property expectations and required Link minima.
NodeTypes do not define Property value semantics.
NodeTypes do not define Link meaning; link_type_ref semantics are owned by Rulesets.
NodeTypes do not define Event or Effect execution semantics.
NodeTypes do not define rendering, animation, geometry, layout or colors.
Additional Properties may exist when their Rulesets resolve them.
Additional Links may exist when their Rulesets resolve them.
Missing expected Properties or required Links make the Entity unready for the relevant Ruleset evaluation; they do not make the canonical Entity invalid.
Input and Output are canonical nodes inside an abstraction and are projected as ports on the containing abstraction when viewed from outside it.
Input and Output MUST NOT declare a copied transported semantic type. Their exposed type is derived by Rulesets from their explicit internal binding.
An Input boundary node does not itself satisfy an internal required Link. It exposes the unresolved requirement through the abstraction boundary.
An Output boundary node exposes an attached internal semantic endpoint outward and creates no requirement by itself.
file_input and file_output use an explicit file Property for the machine-significant filename. Entity.name MUST NOT be used as the filename authority.
UNRESOLVED != INVALID

semantics.required_property_types: Minimum local Property types expected for readiness.
semantics.owned_property_types: Property types structurally associated with this NodeType. This is not a closed allow-list.
semantics.property_cardinality: Optional readiness constraints for local Property counts.
semantics.required_links: Minimum typed Link relations that an Entity of this NodeType must satisfy. Link semantics and matching are resolved by CW_RULESETS.

rules: required_links is an unbounded collection.
id is stable within the resolved NodeType inheritance closure.
link_type_ref selects the applicable Link Ruleset.
self_role MUST resolve to one semantic role defined by that Link Ruleset.
other_endpoint constrains the opposite endpoint when present.
entity_nodetype_ref matching uses NodeType inheritance.
property_type_ref matching uses the resolved canonical Property type.
min is inclusive and MUST be a non-negative integer.
max is inclusive when present, MUST be a non-negative integer, and MUST be greater than or equal to min.
A missing minimum produces unready state.
An exceeded maximum produces a Ruleset finding as defined by CW_RULESETS.
Boundary Input exposure does not increment the satisfied count of the requirement it exposes.

nodetypes.name: Generic
nodetypes.description: Minimal generic canonical node. Link ownership is available to all derived NodeTypes.

nodetypes.name: Input

required_links.description: Input must have exactly one explicit internal boundary binding.
Input belongs to exactly one abstraction boundary.

nodetypes.description: Internal abstraction boundary node. Outside the abstraction it is projected as an input port on the containing abstraction node.

nodetypes.name: Output

required_links.description: Output must have exactly one explicit internal boundary binding.
Output belongs to exactly one abstraction boundary.

nodetypes.description: Internal abstraction boundary node. Outside the abstraction it is projected as an output port on the containing abstraction node.

nodetypes.name: File
nodetypes.description: Declares one external file that must be supplied to the implementation. The required filename is carried by the file Property.

nodetypes.name: File Output
nodetypes.description: Declares one externally materialized output file. The output filename is carried by the file Property.

nodetypes.name: API
nodetypes.description: API boundary or service node. API type plus canonical input/output refs are carried by its api Property.

nodetypes.name: Stream Input
nodetypes.description: External or upstream continuous data input.

nodetypes.name: User Input
nodetypes.description: Human-originated input surface. Concrete semantics are carried by Properties and Links.

nodetypes.name: User Output
nodetypes.description: Human-facing output surface. Concrete semantics are carried by Properties and Links.

nodetypes.name: Stream Source
nodetypes.description: Compatibility NodeType retained for existing CW models; semantically a stream_input specialization.

inheritance.property_cardinality: constraints compose; incompatible inherited constraints are conflict
inheritance.required_links: union by stable requirement id; different active definitions of the same inherited requirement id are conflict

readiness.ready: The Entity satisfies the NodeType Property and required-Link requirements used by the active Ruleset evaluation.
readiness.unready: One or more expected NodeType Properties, cardinalities or required Links are unresolved or missing.

required_links.rule: Authoring tools SHOULD expose Required Links as an editable NodeType collection. Editing Required Links changes the NodeType definition, not an individual Entity instance.

resolution.rule: Entity.entity_type_ref resolves a local NodeType id inside the explicitly active CW_NODETYPES registry. Local ids do not become globally unique merely by spelling.
